messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: - Avoid being near people who are sick or have an infection. Call your doctor if you are exposed to chickenpox or measles.
- Do not have a live vaccine, such as MMR, chickenpox, rotavirus, yellow fever, oral typhoid, or the nasal flu vaccine, without your doctor's approval. Avoid close contact with someone who has just had an oral or nasal live vaccine.
- Limit alcohol. Both alcohol and prednisone irritate the stomach lining, so together they raise the risk of stomach bleeding.
- Be careful with NSAIDs such as ibuprofen, naproxen, and aspirin, since taking them with prednisone raises the risk of stomach bleeding.
- Your doctor may ask you to cut back on salt, since prednisone makes your body hold onto fluid.
Triplet: ["prednisone", "has interaction with", "aspirin"]

The relation 'has interaction with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may produce a pharmacological or physiological effect when co-administered or combined with the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has interaction effect': The co-administration of the subject drug with the specified entity results in a measurable change in pharmacological parameters such as blood levels, duration, or physiological effects.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has metabolism pathway': The subject drug is metabolized or processed through the organ or system specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
